name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version to release (e.g., 1.0.0). If not provided, auto-determined.'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (e.g., codex, glm, kimi) or full name'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  draft-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check actor permissions
        if: ${{ github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa' }}
        run: |
          echo "Error: Only dyoshikawa or cm-dyoshikawa can trigger this workflow."
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve model input
        id: resolve-model
        if: ${{ inputs.model }}
        uses: dyoshikawa/rulesync/.github/actions/select-opencode-model@main
        with:
          input-text: ${{ inputs.model }}

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION="${{ inputs.new_version }}"
          if [ -n "$NEW_VERSION" ]; then
            VERSION="$NEW_VERSION"
          else
            # Auto-determine version using release-dry-run logic
            # This assumes a script or npm command exists to calculate the next version
            # based on conventional commits or similar logic.
            # If no such script exists, we default to patch bump of current version.
            CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
            # Simple patch bump for demonstration; replace with actual release-dry-run logic
            VERSION=$(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F. '{print $1"."$2"."$3+1}')
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Resolved version: $VERSION"

      - name: Update package.json version
        run: |
          npm version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }} --no-git-tag-version

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        id: create-pr
        run: |
          VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          BRANCH_NAME="release/$VERSION"
          
          # Configure git
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          # Create and push branch
          git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to $VERSION"
          git push origin $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Create Pull Request
          gh pr create \
            --title "Release $VERSION" \
            --body "Automated release PR for version $VERSION" \
            --base main \
            --head $BRANCH_NAME \
            --label "release"
          
          echo "pr_url=$(gh pr list --head $BRANCH_NAME --json url --jq '.[0].url')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Draft Release
        run: |
          VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          gh release create v$VERSION \
            --title "v$VERSION" \
            --draft \
            --target main \
            --generate-notes
